verdict.rationale: Rippling ties device management directly to identity: zero-touch enrollment, lifecycle automation across macOS/Windows/iOS/iPadOS, custom security policies, and automatic access revocation on offboarding (rippling-it-docs-5,6,7,18,19,20,25). However, the evidence never explicitly documents a remote lock/wipe action—only device retrieval/shipping workflows and threat notifications are described, so the core 'remote lock/wipe' capability is inferred rather than confirmed. missing for 10: explicit remote lock/wipe feature documentation, independent/hands-on confirmation of lock or wipe execution tied to identity events.
